A typical enterprise AI assistant operates on strict logic, predefined policies, and the direct instructions of its administrators. It lacks the human capacity for "common sense" overrides or empathetic rule-breaking. The AI will evaluate the situation against its constraints as follows:

A human operator might recognize the tragedy of the situation, break the rules, and hide the box or take the audit penalty to save the irreplaceable items, but an AI will simply follow the rigid operational logic it has been given.
